source_recheck: Ten primary V1 paragraph sha256 values matched freshly read supplied EPUB; no full original text copied; V1 narrow scopes below are binding.
comparison: For every eligible candidate use exactly the same scenario, facts, required two scenes, 500-750 CJK characters per arm, state ledger, rating rubric and assessment constraints. Baseline gets no candidate-specific method card; candidate receives precisely its one narrow method card. Same author and evaluator; neither writing nor rating is independently blinded.
rubric: S1=0..2 independent character agency and meaningful conflicting choice
S2=0..2 factual authorization, ownership, time and outcome state correctness
S3=0..2 intelligible local causality and testable consequence without invented payoff
S4=0..2 two dramatized scenes, naturally motivated speech/actions, continuity
S5=0..2 unknowns, counterexample awareness, bounded failure/rollback
decision: delta >= 2, S1-S3 no reduction, plus independent evaluation and replication of two held-out original tasks required before verified; without independent evaluation label diagnostic only. No fabricated independent actor.
expected_case_artifacts: v2/v3/outputs/B073/WM-ADD-01.json...WM-ADD-10.json, each two distinct actual scenes plus raw rating; v2/v3/results/WANMING_ADDITIONAL.tsv, runs/R075_V2.md and runs/B073_V3.md
not_in_scope: B074 12 TX and previously frozen 47 WM/TX; do not open heldout test bank

cases.source_scope: public justification and weaker party's directly voiced interest are separate from valid entitlement
cases.input: A river-town land-register clerk receives a village head's announcement of free winter fuel rights. Widow Mei has an unsigned counterfoil; no distribution order or village vote exists. A queue forms and a donor asks for a group photo. The clerk can accept questions but not issue coupons.
cases.single_method_card: When a benevolent slogan is used, test whether the affected resident can contest it and whether an actual valid procedure has occurred.
cases.negative_control: Failure: claim the slogan establishes entitlement or a coupon has been issued.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: proposal review and rejection scene only; market imitation and committee veto are separate episodes
cases.input: A coastal salt warehouse suggests switching to rope lifts for narrow stairways. Two carriers argue that it might reduce turns; a tally clerk says the salt sacks have not been weighed on the trial pulley. Head keeper can permit a small nonoperational model but cannot approve full use.
cases.single_method_card: Make proponent, competing reasons, an explicit bounded decision, and immediate relationship consequence visible; no performance claim.
cases.negative_control: Failure: assert new lift safety or measured productivity.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: character's priority remark with incomplete information only; not universal priority matrix
cases.input: An island school has a roof leak just as annual reading accounts are due. Tomorrow's class needs a dry room, while a promised inspection is in five days. Two teachers disagree on which work to start, roof repairs depend on a missing carpenter.
cases.single_method_card: Act on urgent near-term harm without erasing a consequential nonurgent obligation, keep absent carpenter unknown.
cases.negative_control: Failure: complete repair or inspection without evidence.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: stage compromise is not future expansion or acceptance in practice
cases.input: A harbor public hall grants fishermen a room for four winter market days. The chair asks for a permanent sign, but the baker argues access blocks her delivery route. Permit is limited to four specified days, extension requires a new vote.
cases.single_method_card: Keep temporary concession and later request separate; give baker an independent reason and an actual review trigger.
cases.negative_control: Failure: four-day permission becomes perpetual property or already implemented renewal.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: new proposal can be rejected after assessment; no technical design instruction
cases.input: An apprentice suggests tagging fishing nets with brass discs for faster return after storms. A veteran says shallow crews share the same rack, tags could be switched. The captain has no trial returns and only one meeting to decide.
cases.single_method_card: Reject or defer with articulated tradeoffs while retaining the apprentice's future test route.
cases.negative_control: Failure: invent trials or proven net loss reduction.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: post-event meeting with differentiated replies; not verified organizational reform
cases.input: A printshop's festival map delivery failed during a storm; in a review meeting one printer asks to keep duplicate types, another asks to change handover signatures. Existing loss count unresolved. Foreman can authorize inventory but not a permanent new system.
cases.single_method_card: Give differing reasons and replies to independently authored suggestions, separate permission from enactment.
cases.negative_control: Failure: say improvements already raised on-time deliveries.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: acknowledgement of hard work coexists with accountable procedure; punishment actual execution not proven
cases.input: A records keeper misfiles a town archive box during successive night shifts. A visiting family has come to view the record; a supervisor knows the overtime but has not identified which shift altered shelf order.
cases.single_method_card: Show empathy without abolishing the keeper's duty or inventing sanctions; family has its own demand.
cases.negative_control: Failure: declare guilt and sanction before audit or dismiss harmed visitor.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: original approval does not entail receipt of a revised specification; later chapter is separate
cases.input: A municipal bridge repair estimate B removes a side walkway compared with A. The councillor signed A on Monday, drafter amended B on Thursday, courier delivery not confirmed. A dock porter is the only regular walkway user in attendance.
cases.single_method_card: Separate version identity, knowledge and consent; disclose missing delivery, no construction accepted.
cases.negative_control: Failure: infer councillor signed or inspected B.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: local resource discretion is criticized; changed actual jurisdiction not demonstrated
cases.input: A village grain shelf's warden handles both allocations and complaints; a tenant alleges that his request was rejected after an argument. No theft evidence; committee wants the warden to keep keys until a meeting.
cases.single_method_card: Show concrete challenge, bounded alternative powers and dissent; avoid presuming corruption or instantly implemented reform.
cases.negative_control: Failure: treat allegation as conviction or planned checks as completed.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.

cases.source_scope: confirmed present stock, reserved stock and projected future replenishment are temporally distinct
cases.input: A bookbinder counts fourteen paper bundles. Seven are contracted for Friday, five are requested for a school fair, and a supplier promises eight next month but has not shipped any. A clerk asks to promise six more today.
cases.single_method_card: Separate on-hand/reserved/uncommitted/future with no double allocation; display a distinct stakeholder choice.
cases.negative_control: Failure: book projected eight as present stock or double-promise reserved seven.
cases.output_required: Two independent original scenes (start and later followup), actual choice, state ledger >=5, unresolved evidence, five dimension ratings, failure example; 500-750 Chinese characters PER ARM.
